name: Al Zaqaziq
scopeLimits: The ranked UN World Urbanization Prospects 2025 point is a population-weighted locator, not a municipal boundary or parcel identity. Official local land/property mapping or registration evidence was found, but no anonymous public parcel polygon was verified for this point. No geometry or owner/address data is retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Public evidence confirms a local governorate spatial-change system and official urban-map products; the available evidence does not establish that these are a parcel registry covering the WUP locator. Egyptian Survey Authority material identifies broader property-map responsibilities, while the Sharkia-specific asset-map program concerns government land. Registry scope is therefore unresolved.
technicalBlocker: The city/governorate spatial unit portal is login-only; the public planning map is at urban-settlement levels rather than parcel-level geometry. No anonymous geometry endpoint was found.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the governorate spatial-change database includes cadastral parcels, whether it covers this point, and whether an authorized public parcel layer exists outside the login-gated portal.
nextStep: If needed, ask Sharkia Governorate or the Egyptian Survey Authority for a public parcel map/service and the city-level coverage scope; do not attempt authenticated portal routes without an authorized account.

executedQueries.query: Al Zaqaziq Egypt official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS Sharkia governorate property registration
executedQueries.scope: Find a city/governorate first-party land registry, cadastral map, public GIS viewer, or parcel-vector service.
executedQueries.result: Official Sharkia Governorate has a Spatial Changes Unit web application at makani.sharkia.gov.eg, but the public route displays an email/password login. Official GOPP provides a governorate urban-map hierarchy and includes Zagazig city in its administrative listing; this service presents settlement/urban levels, not parcel boundaries. No anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was verified.
executedQueries.method: Separate English-language search; official Sharkia Governorate, GOPP and Egyptian Survey Authority sources reviewed.

executedQueries.query: الزقازيق محافظة الشرقية خريطة عقارية سجل عيني مساحي خرائط رسمية

executedQueries.result: بوابة وحدة المتغيرات المكانية الرسمية لمحافظة الشرقية تفتح على تسجيل الدخول فقط؛ ولا تعرض الصفحة العامة واجهة خريطة أو خدمة هندسية. الخريطة العمرانية الرسمية للشرقية تعرض مستويات المحافظة/المركز/الوحدة/القرية/العزبة، ولا تثبت حدود قطع الملكية. لم يتم اختبار أي مسارات خلف تسجيل الدخول.

officialSources.observation: Official Sharkia Governorate Spatial Changes Unit application; public page shows login only, with no anonymous map/query.
Official General Organization for Physical Planning Sharkia urban-map page describing settlement boundaries and a governorate-to-village/hamlet hierarchy; not a cadastral parcel viewer.

Official Egyptian Survey Authority state-property mapping project page lists Sharkia among governorates participating in mapping/state-owned-land inventory; this is not evidence of publicly queryable private parcel data.
Official Egyptian Survey Authority describes its historic production of urban/rural property maps and property books; national scope only.

viewerAndServiceTrace.summary: The public Makani landing route was reviewed and presents only an email/password login for the Sharkia Spatial Changes Unit. No login, credential testing, hidden API call or authentication bypass was attempted. The official GOPP urban-map page describes administrative/settlement-level layers (governorate, center, local unit, village, hamlet) and provides no property-parcel geometry endpoint. ESA’s state-property map inventory lists Sharkia participation but concerns government assets, not a public private-cadastre viewer. No public parcel feature service was found.
